verdicts.decision_note: The freelancer explicitly commits to providing a shareable landing-page link through which recipients can view the page, implementing the client-authorized access behavior.

The client establishes a concrete acceptance condition that the deployed link must work and be clickable so customers can view the product page; the existing access_behavior key is validly replaced without stale attributes.
This is a target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer supplies the landing-page URL and identifies it as the final version, without reporting an executed access test.
